diagnosis: Request combines a billing-contact change with a refund demand, and it originates from an unverified personal address that is not the account owner on record. Per kb-0018, billing/credential changes require confirmation from a named account owner; identity confirmation must be handled by a human. No refund or billing action should be taken or promised before identity is verified.
reply: Thanks for reaching out. Because this request changes billing information and relates to a payment, we can only action it once we've confirmed the request with a named account owner on record, and we can't make changes based on an unverified address. Please have the account owner on file contact us from their registered account details so we can verify and continue. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
